text: > This document describes the architecture of the DeepSeek Harness — the foundation of **DeepSeek Code**. The governing principle, from the microkernel design discussion: **everything is a plugin**. The core is deliberately tiny — a handful of abstract services plus one concrete loop plugin (`dsh-agent-loop`) — and every product feature is a plugin against the extension API described here, without modifying the loop.
reason: Quoted upstream prose retained as a translation style sample; it does not describe DobeeWork as a DeepSeek product.

text: 本文介绍 DeepSeek Harness 整体架构，它是 **DeepSeek Code** 的底层基座。微内核设计讨论中确立了核心设计准则：**一切皆插件**。内核刻意做得极精简，仅包含少量抽象服务，外加一个实体循环插件 `dsh-agent-loop`。所有产品功能均基于本文定义的扩展接口开发为独立插件，无需改动主循环逻辑。
